description: Music/Rhythm mini-game system - play instruments, compose melodies, and complete rhythm timing challenges. Includes a new NPC (Melody the Musician) who hosts the rhythm game, new items (instruments), a rhythm state machine with timing windows, melody composition with note sequences, and integration with achievements.
steps: Create packages/game-engine/src/music/ directory with index.ts, musicDefinitions.ts, musicOps.ts, and musicState.ts

In musicDefinitions.ts: define InstrumentType union (drum, flute, harp, xylophone), RhythmNote interface (timing, lane), SongDefinition interface (id, name, bpm, notes array), NOTE_TIMING_WINDOW_MS constants (perfect/good/miss thresholds), INSTRUMENT_DEFINITIONS with buyable instruments, and 4 built-in songs of increasing difficulty

In musicState.ts: define MusicState type (idle/playing/composing/complete), RhythmResult type (perfect/good/miss), PerformanceScore interface (perfectCount, goodCount, missCount, maxCombo, totalScore)

In musicOps.ts: pure functions - canStartRhythm (check instrument in inventory), startSong (init state from definition), tickRhythm (advance song timer, emit pending notes), hitNote (evaluate timing against window, return RhythmResult), completeSong (calculate final score + coin reward), composeMelody (validate note sequence length 4-16 notes), getComboMultiplier (combo streak bonus)

Create packages/game-engine/src/components/MusicComponent.ts extending Component with type 'music': fields for state, currentSongId, songTimer, noteIndex, combo, maxCombo, score, instrument, composedMelody, version

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/MusicSystem.ts following FishingSystem pattern: requires ['position','interaction','inventory','stats','music'], handles interact requests near the music NPC, advances rhythm timer, processes note hits from a requestHit field, transitions through the state machine, awards coins on completion
Add 'rhythm_drum'|'rhythm_flute'|'rhythm_harp'|'rhythm_xylophone' to ItemId in packages/shared/src/items.ts with ITEM_DEFINITIONS entries (stackSize: 1)
Add ITEM_NAME_KEYS entries for the 4 instruments in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts
Add new NPC 'musician_melody' to packages/game-engine/src/world/NpcCatalogue.ts with role 'musician' (add to NpcRole union), anchorTileX: 10, anchorTileY: 10, schedule with work/rest/market

Add dialogue tree 'melody_music' in packages/game-engine/src/dialogue/dialogueDefinitions.ts with greeting, play rhythm game option (new action kind 'startMusic'), buy instrument option, and explain rules node
Add DialogueAction kind 'startMusic' to the union in dialogueDefinitions.ts
Add achievement conditions: { kind: 'rhythm_perfect', count: number } and { kind: 'rhythm_score', score: number } to AchievementCondition union and AchievementSource in achievementDefinitions.ts
Add 2 achievements: 'first_rhythm' (play one song) with 15 coins reward and 'rhythm_master' (get 3 perfect scores) with 50 coins reward

Add i18n keys to all 12 locale files: npc.melody.name, dialogue.melody.*, music.title, music.start, music.perfect, music.good, music.miss, music.combo, music.score, music.complete, music.compose, item.rhythm_drum/flute/harp/xylophone, achievement.first_rhythm.*, achievement.rhythm_master.*
Export all music module types and functions from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts
Register MusicComponent and MusicSystem in packages/game-engine/src/components/index.ts and systems/index.ts

Create packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/music.test.ts with comprehensive tests: song timing, note hit evaluation (perfect/good/miss windows), combo tracking, score calculation, state machine transitions, composition validation, canStartRhythm checks, system integration tests with entity/world
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes with no errors
pnpm test passes with all new music tests green
pnpm lint passes with zero warnings
All 12 locale files have matching keys for music-related strings
MusicSystem correctly processes the rhythm state machine through idle->playing->complete
Note hit timing correctly classifies as perfect/good/miss based on defined windows
Combo multiplier increases on consecutive hits and resets on miss
Achievement integration: rhythm_perfect_count and rhythm_score fields on AchievementSource
